QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc`/`buffer_alloc_free`." and "It requires `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C` plus `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init calls the setter, but never states it is the only in-tree user of the setter.
